draft_text: Wrenfold's advantage over Fennick-Base may extend to customer-service domains not seen in training.
revised_text: Wrenfold outperforms Fennick-Base on the unseen test sets of the Banking and Travel domains on which it was trained (93.1 vs 91.6 and 92.4 vs 90.9 macro-F1).
rationale: The package only evaluates Banking and Travel, the domains Wrenfold was trained on. No unseen/held-out domain is tested, so generalization to unseen customer-service domains is unsupported. The evidence supports only the in-domain advantage.
